trello.name: Add queue depth alerts for worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet, with warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs, using the same thresholds everywhere.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix retry logic in payment_worker.py by implementing exponential backoff with jitter, capping retries, and sending failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of the front. Add tests that simulate processor 503s.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Bump DB connection pool from 20 to 100 and split worker and API pools in the same config file change.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya. Update the payment incident runbook with new logging links, document the queue drain procedure, and verify that escalation phone numbers are current.

trello.name: Automate status page updates
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate status page updates by wiring the status provider API to the checkout error rate alert so the status page flips to 'investigating' with a template message automatically when the alert fires.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a game day to test payment processor failover in staging and then production during a low-traffic window with a rollback plan. Plan must be drafted first and reviewed in two weeks before any execution.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. Schedule a proper change window using the infra calendar due to config rename and changed persistence defaults.

trello.name: Write incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the incident timeline doc tonight so it goes out tomorrow.

trello.name: Post team lunch headcount to channel
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Post the headcount for Thursday's team lunch at the Thai place to the channel.
